_comment: Copy to apps/<slug>/handles/<handle>/world.json. The handle's world: the fixed subjects (a pet) and the sets (the rooms of the home), shared by the handle's characters and kept the same across slides and videos. Written by persona-identity. Paths are relative to the handle's folder.

fixed_subjects.what: <a pet, a product always held: visible traits only>
fixed_subjects.true_size: <its size in proportion to a person and the furniture>

sets.room: <the room, its furniture and what is behind the person>
objects: <three named objects that are always there>
